snippet.title: Aesirbard – Fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania, First Gameplay Look
snippet.description:
A night in Kerrivik, a fishing village held in safety, or perhaps captivity, under a goddess's ward.

Aesirbard is a fantasy pixel art Metroidvania interwoven with Norse myth. Saved from the gates of Hel, pulled back by the goddess Eir, you fight and fix your way through the the lands. Restoring Kerrivik and reuniting families.

See through the leyveil to rebind the ley itself: link leystones to devices to channel their energy and draw bridges, open gates, turn the village's old machinery to your side, and assist your combat.

All footage is real, unedited gameplay from the current alpha build, with the game's own original music, sound effects, and voices.

#Aesirbard #Metroidvania #PixelArt
